title: B1.10 Standard WOFOST Daily Call and Cadence Evidence

facts: TimeControl selects the current day, then daily meteo is loaded.
crop rotation/emergence is checked before assimilation.
for an emerged detailed crop, assimilation() is called exactly in the flDayStart block.
assimilation shifts atmin7, increments nofd and computes the running minimum-temperature mean including current-day TMN.
astro(daynr,...) derives DAYL, DAYLP and radiation geometry using day number, latitude and daily radiation.
potential and actual daily gross assimilation are computed from pre-growth crop state and current-day weather.
r_pot%pgass and r_act%pgass are prepared daily rates/intermediates; they are not physical continuation state.
daily integrated variables are reset at day start before substep processing.
soil-water timestep reduction/retry occurs inside fldtreduce before SoilWater(3) and integral(3).
integral(3) is called only after the current substep leaves the retry loop.
the three daily accumulators are zeroed at initialization/day start and accumulated over soil-water timesteps.
cropdevelopment(3) is called once in the flDayEnd block.
cropdevelopment(3) calls wofost(3) before root-extension and root-distribution updates.
wofost(3) computes phenology rates, consumes IQROT_DAY/IPTRA_DAY for actual water-stress reduction, updates potential and actual WOFOST trajectories, and then updates vernalisation state when IDSL=2.

fixed_cadence_evidence.meaning: the standard implementation advances biomass, leaf cohorts, TSUM and DVS with an explicit one-day increment per WOFOST update call

source_bound_conclusion: B1.10 standard WOFOST has a real daily process cadence layered over smaller soil-water timesteps. Generic kernel time therefore requires an explicit one-day crop event/window, not replacement of delt=1 by arbitrary solver dt.
